definitions.explanation: The systematic examination and interpretation of data to extract meaningful patterns, draw conclusions, or support decision-making.

examples.japanese: データ{解析|かいせき}の{結果|けっか}を{報告|ほうこく}する。
examples.english: Report the results of the data analysis.

examples.japanese: AIを{使|つか}ったデータ{解析|かいせき}が{注目|ちゅうもく}されている。
examples.english: Data analysis using AI is attracting attention.

examples.japanese: {大量|たいりょう}のデータ{解析|かいせき}を{行|おこな}うためには、{専用|せんよう}のソフトウェアが{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: Specialized software is needed to perform analysis on large volumes of data.

notes:
Composed of データ (data) + {解析|かいせき} (analysis; parsing). A key term in technology, science, and business fields. With the growth of big data and AI, this term has become increasingly common in everyday media.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- データ{解析|かいせき}を{行|おこな}う: perform data analysis
- データ{解析|かいせき}ツール: data analysis tool
- {統計的|とうけいてき}データ{解析|かいせき}: statistical data analysis
- データ{解析|かいせき}{手法|しゅほう}: data analysis method

SIMILAR WORDS:
- データ{分析|ぶんせき}: data analysis — largely synonymous; {分析|ぶんせき} is the more general term while {解析|かいせき} implies more technical or mathematical processing
- {統計|とうけい}{処理|しょり}: statistical processing — focuses on the computational aspect
- データサイエンス: data science — the broader academic and professional field
